lines.en: My youth passed away in the distance,

lines.cyr: тага носам, мајко стара, како планина.
lines.lat: taga nosam, majko stara, kako planina.
lines.en: I carry sorrow, old mother, like a mountain.

lines.cyr: Што сум добил јас, што сум изгубил,
lines.lat: Što sum dobil jas, što sum izgubil,
lines.en: What have I gained, what have I lost,

lines.cyr: каде тебе, еј животе, сум те потрошил?
lines.lat: kade tebe, ej živote, sum te potrošil?
lines.en: where, oh life, did I waste you?

lines.cyr: ќе те памти душо студена, љубов неогреана.
lines.lat: ḱe te pamti dušo studena, ljubov neogreana.
lines.en: will remember you, cold soul, unwarmed love.
Sorrowful are the letters, bitter the wines,

lines.cyr: дали простум ќе ме прими татковината?
lines.lat: dali prostum ḱe me primi tatkovinata?
lines.en: will the homeland receive me, a simple man?
